feature_list.name: Freelancer Authentication & Onboarding
feature_list.description: Users can sign up, verify email, create profile, complete onboarding flow
acceptance_criteria: Users can register with email and password
Email verification required before profile creation
Onboarding flow guides users through profile setup
Profile includes: skills, hourly rate, portfolio links, bio

feature_list.name: Freelancer Profile & Portfolio Display
feature_list.description: Freelancers can create detailed profiles showcasing expertise, experience, and past work
acceptance_criteria: Profile displays: name, skills, experience level, rate, availability
Portfolio section shows up to 5 past projects with descriptions and links
Ratings/reviews from brands visible (v1: seed with dummy data)
Profile is publicly viewable by brands

feature_list.name: Brand Authentication & Onboarding
feature_list.description: Brands sign up and create company profiles
acceptance_criteria: Brands can register with company email
Company verification via domain email required
Company profile: name, description, industry, size, hiring needs

feature_list.name: Project Posting
feature_list.description: Brands post projects with details, requirements, and compensation
acceptance_criteria: Brands can create project with: title, description, required skills, budget/rate, timeline, deliverables
Projects show 'Open' or 'Closed' status
Project detail page shows company info and project specifics
Brands can edit projects while 'Open'

feature_list.name: Project Discovery & Search
feature_list.description: Freelancers discover and search for projects
acceptance_criteria: Freelancers can browse all open projects
Filter by: skill, budget range, timeline, project type
Search by keyword in project title/description
See project details and company information

feature_list.name: Project Interest/Apply
feature_list.description: Freelancers can express interest in or apply to projects
acceptance_criteria: Freelancers can submit application with: cover letter, proposed rate, availability
Applications appear in freelancer's dashboard
Brands receive notifications of applications

feature_list.name: In-App Messaging
feature_list.description: Freelancers and brands can message each other
acceptance_criteria: Users can send/receive text messages within platform
Message history persists
Unread message count displayed
Real-time notifications for new messages

feature_list.name: Basic Agreements & Project Start
feature_list.description: Freelancers and brands agree on terms before work begins
acceptance_criteria: Standardized agreement template with key terms
Both parties can review and accept/decline
Once accepted, project moves to 'Active' status
Freelancer and brand both see project timeline

user_flows.flow_name: Freelancer Signs Up and Browses Projects
steps: Completes profile: skills, experience, rate, portfolio
Views project details and company info
user_flows.happy_path: User successfully completes onboarding and sees relevant projects
edge_cases: User closes browser during onboarding (resume option)

user_flows.flow_name: Brand Posts Project and Reviews Applications
steps: Fills out project form: title, description, skills, budget, timeline
user_flows.happy_path: Brand successfully posts project and reviews qualified freelancers

user_flows.flow_name: Freelancer Applies and Agrees to Project
steps: Freelancer and brand negotiate in messaging
user_flows.happy_path: Successful match and agreement on project terms

entities: Agreement (project terms accepted by both parties)
data_model_overview.relationships: User has one Freelancer or Company Profile. Company has many Projects. Project has many Applications. Users have many Messages. Agreement links Freelancer, Project, and Company.

assumptions_and_constraints: MVP focuses on project posting and basic matching; no automated matching algorithm (manual review v1)
Payments handled manually; Stripe integration for v1.1
No messaging on-platform initially; manual email-based communication (v1.1)
Freelancer vetting is manual (brands review profiles)

concerns: Real-time messaging requires WebSocket setup (can defer to v1.1)
Payment processing adds complexity (can mock in MVP)
buildability_assessment.scope_evaluation: Scope is realistic for 8 weeks with 4-person team. Critical path: Auth → Profiles → Project Posting → Applications → Messaging. All core features achievable.
recommendations: Defer: real-time messaging (use polling or email notifications v1)
Include v1: core profiles, project posting, applications, basic messaging
